steps.text: The first time you open Unscribe, review Terms and Privacy.
Open the Privacy Policy tab and scroll to the bottom.
Then tap I Accept and Continue.
You land on Home. From here you can share a statement or add subscriptions by hand.
To bring in a statement, tap Add subscriptions.
Tap Import a statement.
Share a PDF or spreadsheet from the app that already has it — Unscribe never asks for a bank login. After it reads the file, review what it found, then your list fills in on Home.
This is Unscribe Home. The big number is what these subscriptions cost you every month.
Tap the number to switch between month, year, and day.
Coming up lists the next renewals. Tap one to open that subscription.
Tap the total again until you see the yearly cost.
That is what these subscriptions cost over a full year — easy to miss when you only look at monthly bills.
Open a subscription from the list — here, Fitsphere Gym.
You see what it costs, when it renews, and cancel help for that company.
Tap Cancel it when you are ready. Unscribe opens that company's current cancel page.
Tap the insights icon to see categories and what is creeping up.
Use this when you want the big picture — not just the next bill date.
Open Settings from the top of Home.
Remind me is where you pick how many days before a renewal to get notified — and what time.
Pro unlocks reminders. Free stays on the five-subscription list without them.
Still in Settings, find Export to CSV.
That puts your subscription list in a spreadsheet you keep — so you are never locked in.
Export is a Pro feature. Tap it when you are on Pro to share the CSV.
